{
                            let s = root.main?.batStatus ?? ""
                            let c = root.main?.batCapacity ?? 0
                            if (s === "Charging") return "battery-charging"
                            if (c >= 80) return "battery-4"
                            if (c >= 60) return "battery-3"
                            if (c >= 40) return "battery-2"
                            if (c >= 20) return "battery-1"
                            return "battery"
                        }

bindings.text:
"To get your Kagi session token: - Open kagi.com in your browser, right click, and select "Inspect Element" - Switch to the "Network" tab and filter for "Fetch/XHR" - Type something in the search bar - Click on any entry that's labeled with "autosuggest" - Scroll down until you see an item labelled "Set-Cookie" - You'll see something like `kagi_session=Copy_this_its_long; ...`
Copy the text after the `=` and before the `;` and paste it above, then hit save."
